title: SelfHomeMain
description: Manor system, with a unique home, supports MYSQL！
body:
---

### 原帖链接
[https://www.mcbbs.net/thread-1461960-1-1.html](https://www.mcbbs.net/thread-1461960-1-1.html)

**前置插件：**
- Vault（必须）
- PlaceHolder（可选）
- NBTAPI（可选）

**Pre-installed Plugins:**
- Vault (Required)
- PlaceHolder (Optional)
- NBTAPI (Optional)

---

> Hey, have you heard about single-ended residences, single-ended homes are exclusively prepared for players?
> It has broken away from the traditional territory system, and the large servers with technology modules are prone to crashes (file explosions) due to congestion.
> Implemented the function of single-person single-world, and achieved the function of stable card with over 35+ TPS on a single end.
> And supports setting the maximum number of homes created by a single end.
> (If you are using this plugin as the main plugin for your server, please remove the Multiverse plugin, otherwise it will increase some occupancy!
> The module is highly compatible and will not have issues with machines being unable to mine.
> This plugin's functionality can completely allow you to remove redundant Multiverse-Core plugins~
> Windows/Linux VPS/Panel and most mainstream versions, including higher versions, can all be used!!

> ● 嘿，听说过单端住宅，单端家园只为玩家准备吗？
> Ta摆脱了传统的领地系统，科技模块的大服务器的阻塞容易崩溃（炸文件）。
> 实现了单人单世界的功能，实现了单端35+ tps稳定卡的功能
> 并支持设置单端创建的最大家园数量。
> （如果您正在使用此插件作为您的服务器的主插件，请删除多世界插件，否则会增加一些占用率！
> 模块兼容性强，不会出现机器挖不出来的问题
> 这个插件的功能完全可以让你删除多余的多世界MV插件~
> Windows/Linux VPS/Panel和大多数主流版本，高版本都可以使用！！

---

## 插件介绍

### 中文介绍
- **核心功能**：使服务器达到每个玩家一个单独的世界的功能，减少区块占用卡顿，区块保存困难炸档等问题。并且支持设置单端里的家园最大创建数量。
- **创建家园世界**：支持超平坦/默认生存/及其他设定的模板地图。
- **自定义模板世界功能**：将您的模板地图放置在本插件配置文件根目录文件夹，文件夹名为创建家园时的参数。
- **传送与访问**：
  - 传送回家功能
  - 加入他人家园的功能
  - 拜访他人家园功能
- **家园管理**：
  - 设置家园出生点功能（防止玩家吐槽出生点不好）
  - 添加/移除玩家到信任名单功能（支持*添加所有人）
  - 添加/移除玩家到拉黑列表功能（支持*添加所有人）
  - 家园扩大升级功能（自定义设置花费所需）
  - 家园开启/关闭公开访问功能
  - 家园信息查看功能
  - 家园删除功能
  - 家园资源占用排行榜功能
  - 家园PVP开关
  - 家园拾取物品开关
  - 家园丢弃物品开关
  - 全服家园权限检测功能
- **家园监管**：
  - 家园Tile上限进行预警/关闭世界
  - 家园Entity达到上限进行清理（含生物白名单 可自行配置）
  - 区块方块上限检测（防卡服）
  - 实体黑名单（如禁用村民的刷新，防止养殖出强力兑换）
- **管理员功能**：
  - 家园创建上限功能（可自行配置）
  - 管理员强制关闭家园功能
  - 管理员强制删除家园功能
- **数据安全与优化**：
  - 家园地图自动保存功能（防回档）
  - 家园地图智能自动备份功能（防意外）
  - 可搭配使用边界插件进行使用（本插件自带，但兼容低版本）
  - 对高版本或者纯净服的地图存储类型进行适配，可自定义设置地图路径
    > [默认地图都在world文件夹下，可自行改]  
    > [如果您是纯净服的话，修改配置文件内容为：WorldLocation： ''即可]
  - 家园优化[自定义卸载无人世界或区块]
  - 家园重置限制[防止玩家多次刷新地图更新物资]
- **拓展与兼容**：
  - 家园天气时间管理功能
  - PlaceholderAPI插件支持，支持自定义%SelfHome_Name%，以及Tile总数：%SelfHome_Tile%，兼容多世界插件.
  - 对所有家园世界死亡不掉落[无需其他插件协助开启，方便省力][可开关]
  - 对所有家园世界禁止自然刷怪[科技服不再卡顿][可开关]
  - 大部分主体功能均以异步方式实现，线程优化
  - 高纯度的自定义语言汉化功能，支持95%自行DIY处理.
  - 支持同步文件，实现BungeeCord同步文件达到群组服可用.
  - 支持跨服传送，跨服拜访，智能判断防大厅绕过登入插件的家园BC拓展插件.
  - 公共世界: 地狱和末地，开放统一的世界平台，是多世界插件的平替。
  - 模组兼容性强，对机器破坏权限进行特殊化处理.

### English Introduction (Machine Translation)
Convenient server first plugin, management is fast, efficient, and controllable, now supports cross-server capabilities~

- Enable the server to create a separate world for each player, reducing chunk occupancy lag, difficulty in chunk saving, and bombing issues. Also supports setting the maximum number of houses that can be created on a single server.
- Create a Home World (supports hyperplanes/default survival/etc. preset map templates)
- Custom Template World Function (place your template maps in the root folder of this plugin's configuration file, which is named as a parameter when creating the homepage)
- Teleport Home Feature
- The ability to join someone else's home
- Visit others' homes function
- Set home spawn point function (to prevent players from complaining that spawn points are bad)
- Add/remove players to trusted list function (support * add everyone)
- Add/remove players to blacklist function (support*Add everyone)
- Home expansion upgrade function (custom settings cost required)
- Turn on/off public access in your home
- Home information viewing function
- Home deletion function
- Home resource occupation leaderboard function
- Home PVP switch
- Home pickup switch
- Home Drop-off Switch
- Full server home permission detection function
- Instruction first-level parameters support Tab completion, which is convenient and fast~
- Home Tile Cap for Early Warning/Shutdown World (Home Regulation)
- Home Entity reaches the upper limit for cleaning (including biological whitelist, configurable) (Home supervision)
- Block block cap detection (anti-jam suit, home supervision)
- Entity blacklist (such as disabling the refresh of villagers to prevent strong exchange of farming)
- Home creation cap function (configurable)
- The administrator forcibly turns off the home function
- Administrator forcibly removes the home function
- Home map auto-save function (anti-rollback)
- Home map intelligent automatic backup function (anti-accident)
- Can be used with boundary plug-ins (this plug-in comes with it, but other plug-ins can also be used, compatible with lower versions)
- Adapt to the map storage type of the high version or pure server, and customize the map path [the default maps are all under the world folder, you can change it yourself]
[If you are a pure server, modify the configuration file content to: WorldLocation: '']
- Home optimization [custom unloading of no man's world or block]
- Home reset limit [prevents players from refreshing the map multiple times to update supplies]
- Home weather time management function
- Placeholder API plugin support, support custom %SelfHome_Name%, and total number of tiles: %SelfHome_Tile%, compatible with multi-world plugins.
- No drop for all home world deaths [no need for other plug-ins to help open, convenient and labor-saving] [switchable]
- No natural spawning is prohibited for all home worlds [Tech suits no longer stutter] [switchable]
- Most of the main functions are implemented asynchronously, and the thread is optimized
- High-purity custom language localization function, support 95% DIY processing.
- Support file synchronization, so that BungeeCord synchronizing files can be used in group servers.
- Support cross-server transmission, cross-server visit, intelligent judgment anti-lobby bypass login plug-in Home BC extension plug-in.
- Public World: Hell and the End, an open and unified world platform, is a replacement for multi-world plugins.
- The module has strong compatibility and special treatment for the destruction authority of the machine.

---

## 权限与指令

### 家园独特的氪金权限
- **SelfHome.Level.等级**：不允许超过配置文件上限
- **SelfHome.MaxOP.人数**：最大家园管理员数量
- **SelfHome.MaxJoin.人数**：最大家园信任成员数量
- **SelfHome.Day**：调整家园至白天
- **SelfHome.Night**：调整家园至黑夜
- **SelfHome.LockTime**：锁定家园时间
- **SelfHome.LockWeather**：锁定家园天气

### 插件指令
简单明了没有任何复杂的程序。

- `/SH Home`：传送至自己的家园或已加入的家园
- `/SH Visit`：传送至自己或者有权限的家园
- `/SH Invite`：邀请玩家成为自己家园的主人之一
- `/SH Accept`：接受家园的邀请
- `/SH Kick`：踢出自己家园的管理员
- `/SH SetSpawn`：设置个人家园的传送点
- `/SH Add <玩家名>`：增加信任名单
- `/SH Remove <玩家名>`：删除信任名单
- `/SH Deny <玩家名>`：禁止某玩家访问
- `/SH UnDeny <玩家名>`：允许某玩家访问
- `/SH Create <1/2>`：创建个人生存/超平坦家园/3~11（3~11需要额外给与权限）
- `/SH Update`：升级个人家园，增加边界
- `/SH Public`：开启/关闭个人家园禁止陌生人进入
- `/SH Look`：查看当前家园的信息
- `/SH WholeDelete`：彻底删除家园世界
- `/SH Rank <页数>`：查看第几页的排名
- `/SH TpSet`：设置世界的传送点
- `/SH Quit`：退出当前加入的家园
- `/SH Check`：查询自己含有权限的家园列表
- `/SH Rain`：家园下雨
- `/SH Sun`：家园晴天
- `/SH Day`：家园白天
- `/SH Night`：家园黑夜
- `/SH Nether`：传送到公共地狱
- `/SH End`：传送到公共末地
- `/SH UnLoad <世界名>`：卸载某个世界
- `/SH ForceDelete <世界名>`：OP使用删除家园
- `/SH Mobs`：OP查看家园实体名
- `/SH Reload`：OP重载配置文件

### 插件权限

**SelfHome.command.user**：包含的子权限列表
- `SelfHome.Create.1`：创建默认生存世界家园权限
- `SelfHome.Create.2`：创建默认生存世界超平坦权限
- `SelfHome.Check`：给予查询自己所有家园自己含有的权限列表
- `SelfHome.Public`：设置家园的访问状态
- `SelfHome.Update`：升级家园的权限
- `SelfHome.Look`：查看当前家园的状态
- `SelfHome.Rank`：查看当前家园的占用资源排行榜
- `SelfHome.WholeDelete`：删除自己家园的权限
- `SelfHome.TpSet`：重设置传送点
- `SelfHome.PVP`：切换家园的PVP开关
- `SelfHome.PickUp`：切换家园的拾取开关
- `SelfHome.Drop`：切换家园的丢弃开关
- `SelfHome.Invite`：家园邀请权限
- `SelfHome.Trust`：家园信任权限
- `SelfHome.Deny`：家园添加黑名单权限
- `SelfHome.Quit`：家园退岛权限

**其他权限**（具体看服务器的需求给以下权限）：
- `SelfHome.Visit`：拜访家园权限
- `SelfHome.SetSpawn`：设置家园中心（边界移动）
- `SelfHome.Nether`：是否能前往公共下界
- `SelfHome.End`：是否能前往公共末地
- `SelfHome.Rain`：是否能切换雨天
- `SelfHome.Sun`：是否能切换晴天
- `SelfHome.Night`：是否能切换黑夜
- `SelfHome.Day`：是否能切换白天
- `SelfHome.Create.1`：是否能创建家园类型为1的家园
- `SelfHome.Create.2`：是否能创建家园类型为2的家园
- `SelfHome.Create.?`：是否能创建家园类型为?的家园
- `SelfHome.Create.*`：是否能创建所有类型的家园

**创建地形所需权限**：`SelfHome.N`
> N代表参数，1普通生存，2代表超平坦，其他代表自定义模板的世界  
> 例：缺乏权限无法使用指令 `/SH Create N`

**强制拜访权限**：`SelfHome.forcetp`

其他基本权限玩家默认拥有，管理员指令只有OP可用。
---

## Permissions & Commands

### Unique Monetization Permissions for Home
- **SelfHome.Level.Level**: Cannot exceed the upper limit set in the configuration file
- **SelfHome.MaxOP.Count**: Maximum number of home administrators
- **SelfHome.MaxJoin.Count**: Maximum number of trusted home members
- **SelfHome.Day**: Adjust the home to daytime
- **SelfHome.Night**: Adjust the home to nighttime
- **SelfHome.LockTime**: Lock the home's time
- **SelfHome.LockWeather**: Lock the home's weather

### Plugin Commands
Simple and straightforward with no complex procedures.

- `/SH Home`: Teleport to your own home or a home you have joined
- `/SH Visit`: Teleport to your own home or a home you have permission to visit
- `/SH Invite`: Invite a player to become one of the owners of your home
- `/SH Accept`: Accept an invitation to a home
- `/SH Kick`: Kick an administrator from your home
- `/SH SetSpawn`: Set the teleport point for your personal home
- `/SH Add <PlayerName>`: Add a player to the trusted list
- `/SH Remove <PlayerName>`: Remove a player from the trusted list
- `/SH Deny <PlayerName>`: Ban a player from accessing your home
- `/SH UnDeny <PlayerName>`: Allow a player to access your home
- `/SH Create <1/2>`: Create a personal survival/superflat home / 3~11 (3~11 requires additional permissions)
- `/SH Update`: Upgrade your personal home and expand the boundary
- `/SH Public`: Enable/disable strangers from entering your personal home
- `/SH Look`: View information about the current home
- `/SH WholeDelete`: Completely delete the home world
- `/SH Rank <PageNumber>`: View the ranking for a specific page
- `/SH TpSet`: Set the teleport point for the world
- `/SH Quit`: Leave the currently joined home
- `/SH Check`: Query the list of homes you have permissions for
- `/SH Rain`: Make it rain in the home
- `/SH Sun`: Make it sunny in the home
- `/SH Day`: Set the home to daytime
- `/SH Night`: Set the home to nighttime
- `/SH Nether`: Teleport to the public Nether
- `/SH End`: Teleport to the public End
- `/SH UnLoad <WorldName>`: Unload a specific world
- `/SH ForceDelete <WorldName>`: OP command to delete a home
- `/SH Mobs`: OP command to view entity names in a home
- `/SH Reload`: OP command to reload the configuration file

### Plugin Permissions

**SelfHome.command.user**: List of included sub-permissions
- `SelfHome.Create.1`: Permission to create a default survival world home
- `SelfHome.Create.2`: Permission to create a default superflat world home
- `SelfHome.Check`: Permission to query the list of all homes you have permissions for
- `SelfHome.Public`: Permission to set the access status of a home
- `SelfHome.Update`: Permission to upgrade a home
- `SelfHome.Look`: Permission to view the current status of a home
- `SelfHome.Rank`: Permission to view the resource usage ranking of a home
- `SelfHome.WholeDelete`: Permission to delete your own home
- `SelfHome.TpSet`: Permission to reset the teleport point
- `SelfHome.PVP`: Permission to toggle the PVP switch for a home
- `SelfHome.PickUp`: Permission to toggle the item pickup switch for a home
- `SelfHome.Drop`: Permission to toggle the item drop switch for a home
- `SelfHome.Invite`: Permission to invite players to a home
- `SelfHome.Trust`: Permission to trust players in a home
- `SelfHome.Deny`: Permission to add players to a home's blacklist
- `SelfHome.Quit`: Permission to leave a home

**Other Permissions** (grant the following permissions based on server requirements):
- `SelfHome.Visit`: Permission to visit a home
- `SelfHome.SetSpawn`: Permission to set the home center (boundary movement)
- `SelfHome.Nether`: Permission to access the public Nether
- `SelfHome.End`: Permission to access the public End
- `SelfHome.Rain`: Permission to toggle rainy weather
- `SelfHome.Sun`: Permission to toggle sunny weather
- `SelfHome.Night`: Permission to toggle nighttime
- `SelfHome.Day`: Permission to toggle daytime
- `SelfHome.Create.1`: Permission to create a home of type 1
- `SelfHome.Create.2`: Permission to create a home of type 2
- `SelfHome.Create.?`: Permission to create a home of type ?
- `SelfHome.Create.*`: Permission to create all types of homes

**Permissions Required for Terrain Creation**: `SelfHome.N`
> N represents the parameter, where 1 is normal survival, 2 is superflat, and others represent custom template worlds  
> Example: Lack of permission prevents the use of the command `/SH Create N`

**Forced Visit Permission**: `SelfHome.forcetp`

Other basic permissions are granted to players by default, while administrator commands are only available to OPs.
